courses.overview: 從流體 PDE、資料同化與集合預報延伸至兩個相近領域；共用架構不代表相同數值、許可權或安全保證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend fluid pdes, data assimilation and ensemble forecasts to two neighboring areas; shared architectures do not imply equal values, privileges or guarantees.

related.title: 大型 MPI 平行模擬
related.why: 同用域分解、halo 與數值驗證
related.whyEn: Both use domain decomposition, halos and numerical checks
related.transfer: 同用域分解、halo 與數值驗證
related.transferEn: Both use domain decomposition, halos and numerical checks
related.difference: 天氣模式還需同化和集合不確定性
related.differenceEn: Weather adds assimilation and ensemble uncertainty

place.name: Oak Ridge 公開科學運算城市代表點
place.nameEn: Oak Ridge public scientific-computing city reference
place.coordinateScope: 城市中心近似座標，僅作公開技術脈絡的地理代表點，不是機構地址、裝置位置、登入位置或參訪入口。研究與開源合作分散全球，並非本課所有技術都在此發明或部署。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate city-center coordinates for public technical context, not institutional addresses, equipment, login locations or visitor entrances. Research and open collaboration are global; this does not locate every invention or deployment.

practice: 畫出本課與「大型 MPI 平行模擬」共用的資料／元件介面；以「同用域分解、halo 與數值驗證」指出能保留的條件。
針對「天氣模式還需同化和集合不確定性」改寫一個實驗，列出新增的輸入、單位與可辨別觀測。
將本課量化例移到新情境：沿用有根據的公式、重新指定假設並標記不能移轉的數值。
practiceEn: Draw shared data/component interfaces with large-scale mpi parallel simulation; use "Both use domain decomposition, halos and numerical checks" to identify retained conditions.
For "Weather adds assimilation and ensemble uncertainty", redesign one experiment with new inputs, units and discriminating observations.
Transfer the quantitative example: retain justified formulas, respecify assumptions and identify nontransferable values.

related.why: 皆融合模型與觀測資料

courses.summary: 數值天氣預報計算管線從流體 PDE、資料同化與集合預報連結介面、資料與驗收。地圖是公開研究城市的近似代表點，不代表所有工具在此製造或部署。
courses.summaryEn: Numerical weather-prediction computing pipelines connects interfaces, data and acceptance through fluid pdes, data assimilation and ensemble forecasts. Maps are approximate public research-city references, not claims of manufacturing or deployment.
courses.connection: 從「預報邊界」到「釋出範圍」，將技術定義與可反駁驗證對接。
courses.connectionEn: Connect forecast boundaries to release scope, pairing technical definitions and falsifiable validation.

history.title: 從公開架構到原創教學模型
history.titleEn: From public architecture to original teaching models
history.text: ECMWF 的 IFS 檔案分列動態、同化與物理；玩具 CFL 例是作者假設，不冒充業務模式設定。
history.textEn: ECMWF IFS documents distinguish dynamics, assimilation and physics; the toy CFL calculation is not an operational configuration.

history.year: 科教與協作 / Education and collaboration
history.title: 跨機構、跨版本的工程驗證
history.titleEn: Engineering checks across institutions and versions
history.text: 本課由原始檔案與官方介面出發，使用自製架構、算例和合成資料；城市標記只協助理解協作脈絡，不聲稱可參訪、可登入或具有現場操作許可權。
history.textEn: The course starts from original documents and official interfaces, using original architectures, examples and synthetic data. City markers provide collaboration context, not visits, logins or operational privileges.
